title: The Summit Spotlight

host.name: Marlowe Quinn
host.introLine: Good evening and welcome to the show! I'm Marlowe Quinn, and tonight the only thing that counts is taking part.

intro: Six quick rounds about your time at Brightline Summit.
Every answer earns the same points. There are no right or wrong answers, and your responses are anonymous.

questions.hostLine: We start where every summit starts: the front door and the badge desk.
questions.prompt: How easy was it to register and check in?

questions.hostLine: Next up, the big room. Keynotes, panels and plenty of slides.
questions.prompt: How useful were the main stage sessions for your work?

questions.hostLine: Round three leaves the sessions behind and heads into the corridors.
questions.prompt: How easy was it to meet and talk with other attendees?

questions.hostLine: Time to look at the whole programme at once.
questions.prompt: Which part of the summit was most valuable to you?

questions.hostLine: The microphone is yours for this one. Say as much or as little as you like.
questions.prompt: What should we change for next year's summit?

questions.hostLine: Our final round of the night. One last question before the confetti.
questions.prompt: How likely are you to recommend Brightline Summit to a colleague?

ending: That's our show! Every answer you gave tonight goes to the Brightline team planning next year's summit. Thanks for playing, and good night!
